[SWS_DM_01216] Revoke an authentication
⌈
If the application calls the
ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle::Revoke method of the class
ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle, the Diagnostic Server in-
stance shall set the Authentication State of the client to ‘kDeAuthenticated’.
⌋
